articles.summary: NEW YORK, Feb. 18, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- SunCar Technology Group Inc. (the "Company" or "SunCar") (NASDAQ: SDA), a leader in digitalizing auto insurance in China, integrated ByteDance's Doubao LLM ("Doubao") into its digital auto insurance platform beginning in Q3 2025.
articles.title: SunCar Leveraging Doubao’s Leading AI Technology in China’s Auto Insurance Market
